newsitem.title: TUNISIA: BIAT to raise capital by 20 mln dnr.
newsitem.headline: BIAT to raise capital by 20 mln dnr.

text.p: Banque Internationale Arabe de Tunisie (BIAT), the third largest bank in Tunisia, plans to raise its capital by 20 million dinars to 80 million dinars, sources at the bank said on Wednesday.

The increase would be through the issuing of 1.6 million new shares for subscription and 400,000 shares to be distributed free of charges to current shareholders through incorporation of reserves, they told Reuters.
BIAT made an 11.77 million dinars provisional profit in 1996, up from 9.63 million dinars in 1995.

It is owned by a majority of Tunisian private shareholders. Other shareholders include Italy's San Paolo Bank Holding, Morocco's Wafa Bank, Saudi's National Commercial Bank of Jeddah, France's Societe Marseillaise de Credit and Caisse Centrale des Banques Populaires, Kuwait's Al Ahli Bank and Bank of Kuwait and the Middle East.
The bank is to hold its annual general assembly on May 14.
